encode_float_sequences: encode a numpy array of float values into token sequences using FloatSequences with configurable precision
decode_float_sequences: decode a token sequence list back into float values using FloatSequences decode method
encode_equation_tree: encode a symbolic regression expression tree into a token sequence using the Equation encoder
decode_equation_tree: decode a token sequence list back into a NodeList of expression trees using Equation decode
convert_integer_to_base: convert a decimal integer to a custom base representation using Equation write_int method
